current_bottleneck: Postforecast interval calibration is capped. Symmetric state/horizon scaling, symmetric cell/horizon scaling, and asymmetric lower/upper tail scaling all fail risk-manager readiness. last_result_summary: 604a implemented a monotone median-preserving asymmetric tail adapter with separate per-cell/per-horizon lower and upper scales. Focused tests passed (3 passed). Fitted lower scales were 1.000/1.150/1.750 and upper scales 1.050/1.450/2.150. It scored 4/11: coverage 76.6%, h1/h7/h14/h30 88.4/77.0/76.1/73.3, conditional MAE reduction 7.20%, regime layer2 0/8, turbulent h7/h14/h30 layer1 failed, persistent severe undercoverage worsened to 13.2%, daily-change KS improved to 19/25, level KS 3/25, and pathwise max-jump KS 0.139. Risk-readiness failed and ranked below base 510a and below 603a on worst regime cell.
next_step_recommendation: Do not run another interval-scale/postforecast adapter. The next principled step is post-experiment analysis or paradigm ideation for path-location/stress-allocation mechanisms, or a clear data-requirement conclusion if available history/factors cannot predict sparse stress windows.
